summary: Tested Focus Time + Chat Status DND integration. All 13 backend API tests pass. Frontend tests pass - Chat page loads without errors, DND banner visible when user is in focus mode, StatusDot component renders correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Code correctly implements all requested features:
- GET /api/chat/my-status returns status_mode='dnd' when user has active focus time
- GET /api/chat/users includes status_mode field for each user (online/dnd/offline)
- GET /api/chat/conversations returns other_status field for direct conversations
- StatusDot component renders green dot for online, orange dot for dnd/busy, no dot for offline
- DND banner (data-testid='chat-dnd-banner') shows 'Nicht stoeren aktiv' when user is in focus mode
- Chat header shows 'Nicht stoeren' label when partner is in DND mode
- WebSocket connect sets status_mode based on focus time check
